scope: every sense authored in shard 9, drawn complete rather than sampled

entries.definition: conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain standard - conformity to the fact or the model, claimed without drama.

entries.definition: marked by fidelity to an original
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Fidelity with the gap admitted: it stays near the original rather than claiming to match it.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Emphatic and informal; the admiration is for the aim as much as for the truth.
examples: She avoids big scenes … preferring to rely on small gestures and dead-on dialogue

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Leaves no margin at all, and says so with some satisfaction.

entries.definition: marked by fidelity to an original
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Fidelity treated as a kind of loyalty, as though the original were owed something.
examples: a faithful copy of the portrait
a faithful rendering of the observed facts

entries.definition: characterized by minimal distortion in sound reproduction
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The clipped form, and friendlier than *high-fidelity* for making the same claim.

entries.definition: characterized by minimal distortion in sound reproduction
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A technical grade rather than praise - it states how little the sound was altered.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The everyday word; it settles the matter without dwelling on how exact the exactness is.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Accuracy as honesty - nothing bent to suit anyone.
examples: made sure the facts were straight in the report

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Precision imagined as controlled and deliberate, cutting where intended and nowhere else.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The flight went where it was aimed; the praise is for the aim, not for the truth of a statement.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and exacting, treating precision as a virtue worth a long word.

entries.definition: (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A call, not a judgement; it locates the pitch and implies nothing about the pitcher.

entries.definition: characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the error in the thing itself, as a defect it carries rather than a slip it made.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Measured and impersonal - it faults the result without accusing anyone of carelessness.

entries.definition: characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The cool formal verdict - it marks the failure against the rule and stops there.

entries.definition: (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely positional, and plainer than *away* for saying where the pitch went.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A failure of trust rather than of aim - what it names has let someone down.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The miss is measured as distance, and the word says nothing about how bad it was.
examples: the arrow was wide of the mark
a claim that was wide of the truth

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The full phrase makes the miss vivid, and can carry a note of mild ridicule that *wide* alone does not.
examples: the arrow was wide of the mark

entries.definition: characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and total; where *incorrect* grades a performance, this simply refuses it.
examples: the wrong side of the road

entries.definition: (superlative of ‘good’) having the most positive qualities
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The superlative itself - it closes the comparison rather than making one.
examples: the best film of the year

entries.definition: holding first place in a contest
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: First place won against others; the contest comes with the praise.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Rank asserted flatly; it orders things and leaves the reason unsaid.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and a little ceremonious - it places something ahead as a matter of standing.
examples: the foremost figure among marine artists

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Quality stated as a classification, the way a supplier states it.

entries.definition: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same bounded best, worn as an adjective of analysis rather than of praise.

entries.definition: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Best within limits - it carries the constraint it is best under wherever it goes.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Slangy and enthusiastic; the enthusiasm is the point, not the grading.

entries.definition: holding first place in a contest
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same first place, evidenced - it points at the award rather than at the quality.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Best measured against history rather than against rivals present.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with the loss inside it - a high place named together with the fact of not holding the highest.

entries.definition: (used especially of merchandise) very fine in quality
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A grading word for goods, pitched a step above *fine* and doing its work by the pitch alone.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Grading language again, pushed to the top of the scale rather than merely high on it.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest strong claim about quality, with nothing held back and nothing specified.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sets the comparison as wide as it will go, which is the whole of the compliment.

entries.definition: forming or having the nature of a turning point or crisis
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names the turning point and the danger in it at once; the word is tense.
examples: a critical point in the campaign

entries.definition: of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Importance at its sharpest - something turns on this, and the turning is what the word insists on.
examples: a crucial moment in his career

entries.definition: forming or having the nature of a turning point or crisis
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same turning point read from the other side - what settles the matter rather than what threatens it.

entries.definition: of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The broad word for weight, pressed here into service at crisis strength.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The stakes stated as plainly as they can be, which is where the phrase gets its force.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same stakes with the alternatives set against each other, which sharpens the choice.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Importance defined by what swings on it: everything else moves around this one point.
examples: Its pivotal location has also exposed it to periodic invasions

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A fixed point that others take their bearings from, rather than one events turn on.
examples: the polar events of this study

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Reliability stated as an outcome - it will work, and the working is not in doubt.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer than *reliable*: it suggests someone is doing the depending.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain word - trust earned by behaving the same way every time.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same confidence, shorter and more casual, and readier to be said out loud.
examples: a sure way to distinguish the two
wood dust is a sure sign of termites

entries.definition: tested and proved to be reliable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Trust backed by having been put through something rather than merely assumed.

entries.definition: tested and proved to be reliable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The testing was long as well as real, and the length is the recommendation.

entries.definition: tested and proved to be reliable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Quiet approval; it says only that the thing has been used and did not fail.

entries.definition: tested and proved to be reliable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The pairing does the work - the testing and the verdict in one breath, with some fondness.

entries.definition: used of values and principles; not subject to change; steady
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Steadiness treated as a virtue of principle, praising what refuses to bend.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Keeping framed as husbandry: what matters is that nothing was spent or lost.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Ongoing effort, plainly said - the condition is the result of continued work.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The formal word for that same effort, crediting the routine rather than the care.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A statement of possibility rather than of condition; nothing has been kept yet.

entries.definition: kept intact or in a particular condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Deliberate keeping - the condition held on purpose rather than by luck.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Safety supplied from outside - the word implies a guard as much as a state.

entries.definition: continued in your keeping or use or memory
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Cool and possessive; it says something was not let go, without praising the holding.
examples: in … the retained pattern of dancers and guests remembered

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Rescue rather than upkeep: it implies the loss came close and did not happen.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving of the result, and of whoever is answerable for it.

entries.definition: in a more fortunate or prosperous condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Comparative by construction; it means something only against the state someone was in before.
examples: she would have been better off if she had stuck with teaching
is better off than his classmate

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and pleased, treating the good fortune as elegant rather than merely welcome.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Insists on the chance: the good outcome arrived unsteered.
examples: profits were enhanced by a fortuitous drop in the cost of raw materials

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval with the surprise kept in - the good turn was neither earned nor expected.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The barest approval available - the result went the right way, and nothing more is claimed.
examples: it's a good thing that I wasn't there
it is good that you stayed

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Good fortune, not gladness - the luck sits in the outcome rather than in anyone's feelings.

entries.definition: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Gratitude pitched high - the timing was so apt it invites the comparison the gloss makes.
examples: a heaven-sent rain saved the crops

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain and cheerful; it credits the chance and takes nothing away from the person.

entries.definition: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The strongest of the three: it does not merely note the aptness, it marvels at it.

entries.definition: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The graver word for that aptness, and it treats the rescue as intended rather than lucky.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Fortune as a position someone occupies rather than an event that befell them.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval of how a thing turned out, judged by the ending rather than by the doing.
examples: it is well that no one saw you

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Held poised for the moment it is wanted, which puts the weight on the waiting rather than the preparing.
examples: soldiers with guns at the ready
students with pens and notebooks at the ready

entries.definition: (usually followed by ‘to’ or ‘for’) on the point of or strongly disposed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Inclination rather than preparation - the disposition is there, and nothing has been made ready.
examples: in no fit state to continue

entries.definition: in a state of proper readiness or preparation or arrangement
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Readiness as tidiness - each thing in its place, measured against a standard of proper arrangement.
examples: everything is in order for their arrival

entries.definition: (usually followed by ‘to’ or ‘for’) on the point of or strongly disposed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Someone did the preparing, and did it deliberately - the readiness was loaded in.

entries.definition: ready and willing or quick to act
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for the speed of the response and for the willingness behind it.
examples: she is always prompt to help her friends

entries.definition: completely prepared or in condition for immediate action or use or progress
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain word - preparation finished, with nothing left to do before starting.
examples: the bridge is ready to collapse
the soup will be ready in a minute

entries.definition: being and remaining ready and available for use
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The doubled phrase makes a small boast of it: not merely available but conspicuously so.
examples: an impressive array of food ready and waiting for the guests

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Readiness arrived at by itself rather than assembled, and it brings eagerness with it.
examples: the colonists were ripe for revolution

entries.definition: (usually followed by ‘to’ or ‘for’) on the point of or strongly disposed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Flat and final; the arrangement is fixed and all that remains is the signal.
examples: we are set to go at any time

entries.definition: being and remaining ready and available for use
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Patient and unexcited - it stresses that the readiness persists, not that it is keen.
examples: waiting cars and limousines lined the curb
found her mother waiting for them
an impressive array of food ready and waiting for the guests

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Financial safety framed as something others can rely on rather than something merely held.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The mildest way to say the money is safe; it reassures without describing anything.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds working order to safety: the money is not merely intact, it is doing its job.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Concerned with what cannot be lost rather than with what might be gained.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Safety that has been arranged and held in place, not simply enjoyed.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Unglamorous, weighty approval - it promises holding rather than growth.
examples: the bank is solid and will survive this attack

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Solidity all the way through - it says the finances would survive inspection.

entries.definition: firm and dependable; subject to little fluctuation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for the absence of movement; what recommends it is that it does not swing.
